entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: The catalyst is the hawkish minutes and the half-point remark. If the break cannot extend after that communication, the catalyst has been spent.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: The short pays if the 20-day downside break extends while dollar-franc and the Australian dollar keep the dollar bid.

entry_rationale: The swing is a concentrated euro short. Euro at 1.0968 is through the 20-day low after hawkish minutes, dollar-franc and the Australian dollar confirm the dollar bid, and dollar-yen at 159.42 is not the break. The March funding short that was covered at 4.54 is not reopened, and the euro is a different expression of the same hawkish dollar path.
